interface.shortDescription: Map your local Codex work into goals, initiatives and honest progress.
interface.longDescription: PrioriTree reads your local Codex projects and selected conversations to build a work map. Review the AI's proposals, accept or reject claims and keep decisions in your own local store. Includes an interactive MCP App, a setup skill and the Map my work prompt. A single background engine re-reads changed Codex chats and checks them each morning. No cloud sync or task execution.
